purpose: Permitting, compliance, and regulatory checklist for Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing engagements. Covers data governance, OT cybersecurity, industrial safety, and IT/OT convergence approvals.

permits.permit_name: OT Network Segmentation & Firewall Rule Approval
permits.why_needed: Changes to OT network topology (VLAN segmentation, DMZ creation, firewall rules) require formal approval from the OT change control board and plant management to prevent production disruption
required_inputs: Solution architecture network topology diagram
Firewall rule set with zone/conduit mapping
Impact assessment for each affected production line
dependencies: Solution architecture design approved by ARB
permits.evidence_required: Signed OT change control board approval; firewall rule set baselined in change management system

permits.why_needed: Installation of edge gateways, sensors, cameras, and compute nodes in production areas requires area owner approval and PTW coordination for installation windows
required_inputs: Edge device bill of materials with mounting locations
Installation schedule with production window requests
HSE risk assessment for installation work
dependencies: Procurement completed; devices received and inspected
permits.evidence_required: Signed area owner approval; PTW issued for each installation window

permits.permit_name: IIoT Data Collection and Privacy Consent
permits.why_needed: Collection of machine, process, and operator data may be subject to data privacy regulations (GDPR, local equivalents), works council agreements, and client data governance policies
required_inputs: Data inventory with classification (machine/process/operator)
Data flow diagram showing collection, storage, and access
Privacy impact assessment
permits.evidence_required: Signed data privacy consent; works council agreement (if applicable); data classification register

permits.why_needed: Connecting OT and IT networks requires a security risk assessment per IEC 62443-3-2 to define zones, conduits, and target security levels, ensuring the converged architecture meets the client's risk appetite
required_inputs: Network architecture diagram with zone/conduit boundaries
Asset inventory (all connected OT/IT devices)
Risk appetite statement from client CISO
dependencies: OT discovery and asset register completed
permits.evidence_required: IEC 62443-3-2 risk assessment report; zone/conduit diagram signed off; target security levels per zone documented

permits.why_needed: Vendor or SI remote access to OT systems (for support, model updates, or troubleshooting) requires formal approval, access logging, and time-boxed credentials per OT security policy
required_inputs: Remote access request form with scope and duration
Vendor security credentials and background check (if required)
Access logging and monitoring plan
dependencies: Remote access solution (VPN/jump box) deployed and tested
permits.evidence_required: Signed remote access approval; access credentials issued with expiry date; logging enabled

permits.permit_name: Cloud Data Residency and Export Compliance
permits.why_needed: Production data sent to cloud platforms may be subject to data residency requirements (data must stay in-country) and export control regulations for sensitive industrial IP
required_inputs: Cloud architecture diagram with data flow across regions
Data classification (production, quality, IP, personal)
Cloud provider data residency commitment
dependencies: Cloud platform selected and contract terms reviewed
permits.evidence_required: Cloud data residency commitment from provider; legal sign-off on data export compliance; data processing agreement executed

permits.permit_name: Production Window Approval for Network Changes
permits.why_needed: Network changes (cabling, switch configuration, firewall rule updates) in or near production areas require scheduled production windows to avoid unplanned downtime
required_inputs: Detailed change plan with timeline and backout procedure
Risk assessment for production impact
Communication plan for affected shifts
dependencies: Change plan reviewed by OT change control
permits.evidence_required: Signed production window approval; change record in CAB system; post-change verification report

permits.why_needed: Deploying AI/ML models that influence production (quality predictions, PdM recommendations, closed-loop control) requires formal validation, safety review, and plant management sign-off
permits.responsible_role: Plant Manager / Quality Manager / OT Engineering
required_inputs: Model validation report (accuracy, precision, recall, false positive rate)
Safety assessment for model failure modes
Monitoring and rollback plan
dependencies: Model tested on historical hold-out set
permits.evidence_required: Model deployment approval signed by plant manager; monitoring dashboard operational; rollback procedure documented

permits.permit_name: OT Patch and Update Approval Process
permits.why_needed: Applying firmware/software updates to OT devices (PLC, edge, firewall, historian) requires formal testing and approval to avoid production disruption from incompatible updates
required_inputs: Vendor patch release notes and CVE details
Test plan for patch validation on representative device
Rollback procedure
dependencies: Patch test environment available and representative
permits.evidence_required: Patch test results; signed CAB approval for production deployment; backout plan documented

permits.why_needed: Connected OT/IT environments increase the attack surface; a formal incident response plan specific to OT incidents must be established and reviewed by the CISO and plant leadership before commissioning
required_inputs: OT incident response plan document
RACI for incident response team
Communication and escalation template
permits.evidence_required: Incident response plan signed off by CISO and plant manager; tabletop exercise completed with key stakeholders
